title: The Eightfold Script
subtitle: The Greater rite of the Scriptorium
text: Inscribe something at the Scriptorium yourself. At the fifth Degree, with your blood awake, the Mnemonist offers a free Rubricator's Quill. A crafted or gifted quill works too, but never replaces your practice; ask him before spending materials. Seat the Scriptorium two blocks behind a Cardinal Focus on a Greater working floor. Light six braziers: the quill, an Ink Sac, a Feather, a block of lapis, Cuttlefish Chromatophores, and Runic Motif Paper. Plant your Living Staff, fill four anchors, seal the daemon, close two circuits with 50 mL each, then finish the procession. The same station keeps its contents and lets you target one enchantment and raise it a level. Its tier survives moving. Cancellation returns offerings and Staff, not spent blood.
